codeReview.summary: Verified secret security implementation. The commit (66cf84e) contains only a formatting fix for concurrency_test.go - the secret-security feature was verified against existing implementation without code changes. Security requirements are properly met: keys stored in K8s Secrets with base64 encoding, mounted as read-only volumes, never exposed in API responses or DB records, and config files use env:// references instead of actual keys.

summary: Secret security feature passes scrutiny. Security implementation is correct: (1) API keys stored only in K8s Secrets with base64 encoding via secret/manager.go:encodeAPIKeys(), (2) Keys not in DB - evaluation model uses APIKeyRef reference field, repository only queries api_key_ref, (3) Keys not in API responses - models_handler.go returns static model list (gpt-4, claude, qwen) without any keys, (4) Keys not in logs - configmap generator uses env:// references instead of actual values, (5) Keys securely mounted - job/creator.go mounts Secret volume as read-only at /etc/api-keys with mode 0400. All tests pass and code follows Go conventions. Minor issue: IsKeyExposedInData detection pattern is incomplete.
